## What is Saphira AI

Saphira AI is a proactive personal assistant and multi-agent executive runtime.
She is the single user-facing identity of the Nova Umbrella ecosystem.
Internal specialist agents remain secret-masked behind a fixed executive pipeline:

```
Saphira (intent) → Aura (perception) → Agent Two (security) →
Nova Reign (governance) → NovaAethrea (memory) → Agent Zero (execution)
```

Key characteristics:
- Conversational agentic companion (not a transactional chatbot)
- Local-first and cloud-hybrid options
- Voice (STT/TTS), face recognition (consent-gated), browser automation
- CommercialAuthorityPolicy (ALLOW / REQUIRE_APPROVAL / DENY) + audit
- Android + Flutter downloadable clients
- 1,000-capability registry routed through the fixed pipeline

## Technical focus areas

- Multi-agent systems and hierarchical orchestration
- Edge / on-device AI and WebGPU acceleration
- FastAPI backends and MCP-style tool fabric
- ONNX wake-word and speech pipelines
- pgvector / hybrid memory
- Governance, policy gates, and self-healing recovery
- Android VoiceInteractionService + accessibility bridges
